description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for OpenWrt firmware, including image checks, upgrade procedures for different hardware models, and configuration copying routines.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the current platform hardware.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures based on the hardware model.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration files based on the hardware model.
